name: My Naughty Secretary: Private Overtime
source:
Your marriage has become little more than a business arrangement, while your life is an endless cycle of meetings, paperwork, and obligations. Then a new secretary walks into your office — Emily Hart.

She is smart, charming, and dangerously attractive. What begins with innocent flirting and lingering glances slowly develops into a forbidden attraction that becomes harder and harder to ignore.

But romance is only the beginning.

Emily discovers a confidential agreement bearing your signature — a document you never signed. Suspicious access logs, anonymous messages, and secrets buried inside the company suggest that someone is playing a much bigger game.

Who can you trust? And how much are you willing to lose for the truth — and for Emily?

Make choices throughout the story, shape your relationship with Emily, investigate the conspiracy, and decide what kind of future remains when every secret finally comes to light.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5041810/My_Naughty_Secretary_Private_Overtime/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你的婚姻早已沦为一场名存实亡的利益联姻，而你的生活不过是会议、公文与应酬周而复始的无尽循环。直到一位新任女秘书走进了你的办公室——艾米莉·哈特。

她聪慧干练、优雅迷人，散发着令人难以抗拒的危险魅力。起初只是无伤大雅的调情与流连不去的目光，渐渐演变成了一股越来越难以忽视的禁忌吸引。

然而恋情仅仅是个开始。

艾米莉偶然发现了一份签有你大名的机密协议——一份你本人从未签过字的文件。可疑的访问日志、匿名的神秘消息，以及深埋在公司内部的黑幕，无不暗示着有人正在下一盘大得多的棋。

你究竟还能信任谁？为了查明真相——也为了艾米莉——你又愿意付出多大的代价？

在故事进程中步步抉择，塑造你与艾米莉的关系，追查幕后阴谋，并决定当所有秘密终于水落石出之时，前方还将留下怎样的未来。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5041810/My_Naughty_Secretary_Private_Overtime/]Steam[/url]]
